# Cheat Sword

Internal ID: SwordCheat | Type: Sword | Source: Console Commands | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Attack speed: 1.84 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.7 range, 10 angle, 1.0 height, 0.7 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Cheat Sword is a sword that is only available with console commands.
Its primary attack is a 3 hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 3x damage.
It deals massive damage to all creatures, rocks and tree while having a cosmetic rainbow sparkle effect when equipped. Unlike the Cheat Sledge, its durability does not degrade with use, and it does not have a durability meter. It can't be repaired by any crafting station (though, it is invincible so doesn't need to be).

Categorias: Weapons, Swords
